lang.label: ಭಾಷೆ
dash.offline: No internet. Showing the last saved forecast from {{when}}.
dash.stale: Live weather is temporarily unavailable. Showing the last forecast.
dash.noVoice: Read aloud is not supported on this phone.
dash.how: How is this local forecast made?
dash.how1: The forecast starts from weather-model data that covers a wide area (about 10 to 25 km).
dash.how2: We ask for the exact point of your Panchayat, so temperature is corrected for its height above sea level.
dash.how3: We compare it with your block centre so you can see what changed locally.
dash.how4: Two weather models are compared. If they disagree, confidence is lower.
dash.how5: Advice comes from simple rules based on India Meteorological Department rain categories. Please treat it as guidance and follow local officers' advice too.
dash.elev: Height of your Panchayat: {{a}} m. Block centre: {{b}} m.
dash.elevEffect: Height difference changes temperature by about {{c}} °C.

alerts.none: No warnings for the next 3 days. We will show any new alert here.
alerts.notifyDesc: Get a notification on this phone when the app finds a new warning. Works when the app is open or installed.
alerts.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
alerts.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
alerts.smsDemo: Demo mode: nothing is actually sent. You will see the message that would be delivered.
alerts.testBody: Notifications are working on this phone.
about.title: ಕಿಸಾನ್‌ಮೌಸಮ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ
about.purpose: Transform block-level weather forecasts into Panchayat-specific, actionable agricultural advice using AI, helping farmers make better crop management decisions.
about.dataDesc: {{n}} Panchayats across {{s}} states and UTs, from open government-derived datasets (CC0).
about.dataNote: Locations are representative points inside each Panchayat boundary. Some states use Bhuvan codes instead of LGD codes, marked in the app.
about.gaps: Not all Panchayats could be listed: about 53,000 boundary polygons in the source have no name or LGD code, so they are left out rather than guessed.
about.weatherDesc: Open-Meteo forecast models, refined for each Panchayat's exact location and height. This is a baseline; a model trained on IMD weather-station data is the planned upgrade.
about.adviceDesc: Simple rules based on IMD rain categories. Crop tips should be reviewed by a Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agriculture officer.
about.install: Tip: add this app to your home screen from the browser menu to use it like an app.
onb.1.d: Pick your state, district, block and Panchayat, or use your location.
onb.2.d: Rain, temperature and wind for the next 7 days at your Panchayat.
onb.3.d: Clear steps: when to irrigate, when to wait, and how to protect your crop.
footer.disclaimer: Prototype for Smart India Hackathon. Advice is general guidance; please also follow your local agriculture officer.
dash.chartHint: ತಾಪಮಾನ, ಮಳೆ, ಆರ್ದ್ರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಂದಿನ 24 ಗಂಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.
